episodes.notes: First episode under the Oct 2026 AI alignment/ethics focus (D48). Two-column script v1.7 (spoken draft v7, about 1,500 words, roughly 11 min estimate); visual-concept and script-audit run (earlier versions) with fixes applied; retroactive research-audit CONDITIONAL; independent fact-check of v6 (Oct 8) found no failures; its wording fixes and clarity fixes are applied in v7. All 12 stills generated (Oct 7-8) and upscaled 4x (Real-ESRGAN, stills-4k; local, git-ignored). Visual-spec done (Oct 8-11): 28 Remotion data files and a hand-wired assembly manifest (D49; first wired as 53 segments on an 11:19 estimate; no placeholders). Its 22 still segments are drawn in Remotion from the full-resolution stills with a framing per use (StillFrame); it also has one AI image-to-video clip and two stock clips. Measured visual QA (npm run qa:episode): see _status and remotion-templates/out/qa/ai-care-motives/report.md for the run after the Oct 12 re-cut. Archival photos, the EPA notice and two stock clips sourced Oct 10 (asset-manifest.json). The two 36 + 59 slots are typed reconstruction cards; their wording is a paraphrase until the exact lines are confirmed. Audio plan written Oct 10 and thinned Oct 11 (audio/audio-cue-sheet.md: 6 music cues, 4 transition sounds, 2 texture hits; no audio files sourced yet). The manifest is timed to a synthetic scratch read re-paced to 160 words a minute (Oct 12; 9:36, 89 segments). Its mode reads precise, but the word timings are a machine read, a timing aid only: no narration is recorded and no voice file is referenced. Tiger's own read replaces it through tools/assembly/retime_manifest.py. Pace and cutting (Oct 12, adopted by Tiger after comparing two cuts): eighteen stills are cut into 2 to 5 framings each on sentence boundaries (one cut every 6.5 s, no still held longer than 7 s) and two clips from the toolbox exploration are in (the river pull, the walk away). The current cut with the synthetic voice is remotion-templates/out/preview/ai-care-motives/density-pass-SYNTHETIC-VOICE.mp4. Face rule (Oct 12): an audit found a breach in eleven of the twelve stills; by Tiger's decision only the three heads that read as a face part were fixed (both figures in aigen-08, the glasses in aigen-06), and the rule applies in full from the new look onward (project/visual-identity/face-audit-2026-10-12/). The two 36 + 59 cards are statements in our own words, subtitled Our summary of a published example · Anthropic, 2025 (Oct 12, Tiger's choice; they replaced a typeset exchange whose wording was a paraphrase). Remaining: audio sourcing, Tiger's narration (then retime_manifest.py, not generate_manifest.py), final render.
